# moha.expert

> Moha Aghanoori — AI consulting and one-to-one coaching for working professionals
> (dentists, lawyers, tax advisors, researchers, marketers). Berlin, English and German.
> Six years building AI systems. You deal with him directly; no agency, no handoffs.

Honest note on this file: as of 2026 no major LLM provider consumes /llms.txt as a
ranking or citation signal, and Google Search states in writing that it ignores it.
It exists here because it costs nothing to maintain and the agentic-browsing
convention may yet go somewhere. The file every engine actually reads is
/sitemap.xml.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://moha.expert/): what he does, who he helps, how it works, pricing approach, FAQ.
- [Startseite (Deutsch)](https://moha.expert/de/): dieselben Inhalte auf Deutsch.

## Use cases

- [Content creators](https://moha.expert/work/content-creators/): scripts, captions and research without losing your own voice.
- [Buying a home](https://moha.expert/work/buying-a-home/): a property search that reads every listing and checks documents before viewing.
- [Finding a job](https://moha.expert/work/finding-a-job/): a matching tool that reads each ad in full; around twenty people placed.
- [Research](https://moha.expert/work/research/): reading, summarising and reference workflows for PhD students and professors.
- [Marketing & product](https://moha.expert/work/marketing-product/): surveys, catalogues and reports distilled, with sources.
- [Language & exams](https://moha.expert/work/language-exams/): IELTS and exam prep aimed at the weakness costing the most points.
